newsitem.title: UK: UK's Knight says few signs of inflation pressures.
newsitem.headline: UK's Knight says few signs of inflation pressures.

text.p: Angela Knight, economic secretary to the British Treasury, said there were few signs of inflationary pressures in the pipeline.
"Of course we look at the improvement in sales, the improvement in manufacturing," Knight said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.

"We take into account some of the other factors, like for example, there is very little sign of any sort of inflationary pressures in the pipeline for raw materials and so on, and there is the strength of the pound," she said.
She said those are all items that have to be taken into account when deciding the future course of interest rates.

Earlier, the Office for National Statistics said retail sales rose 0.6 percent month-on-month in January, twice economists predictions. That gave a year-on-year rise of 4.6 percent compared with a 3.0 percent rise in December.
